kind.contact: Form-type label. Localizes the PICKER only — field label seeds in forms.schema stay English in labels.en; PL is authored in the builder (ADR-0011 / ADR-0025). 1 word.
kind.waitlist: Form-type label for a sign-up-early list. Picker label only; the token stays 'waitlist'. ≤2 words.
kind.wishlist: Form-type label for a wanted-features/products list. Picker label only. ≤2 words.
kind.feedback: Form-type label for a feedback form. Picker label only. 1 word, plural reads better in Polish.
fieldType.text: Label for the persisted field-type token 'text' (single-line input). Shown as a badge and as a select option. 1 word. The token itself is never translated — it is what gets written.
fieldType.email: Label for the field-type token 'email'. 1 word.
fieldType.textarea: Label for the field-type token 'textarea' — a multi-line box. Describe it, don't transliterate 'textarea'. ≤2 words.
fieldType.number: Label for the field-type token 'number'. 1 word.
fieldType.tel: Label for the field-type token 'tel' — a phone number. 1 word.
fieldType.url: Label for the field-type token 'url'. Stays 'URL' in both languages — technical identifier.
fieldType.checkbox: Label for the field-type token 'checkbox'. ≤2 words.
fieldType.select: Label for the field-type token 'select' — a dropdown with fixed options. ≤2 words.
list.title: Page heading of the form list. Noun, plural, 1 word.
list.analytics: Top-bar link from the list to the analytics page. Noun, 1 word.
list.columns.name: Table column header: the form's name. 1 word.
list.columns.kind: Table column header: the form type (contact/waitlist/…). 1 word. CSS uppercases headers, so give sentence case.
list.columns.slug: Table column header: the URL slug. Glossary: slug stays 'slug'. 1 word.
list.columns.submissions: Table column header: how many submissions the form collected. Glossary: submission → zgłoszenie. 1 word.
list.status.active: Status badge on a form that accepts submissions. 1 word, adjective agreeing with 'formularz' (masculine) in Polish.
list.status.inactive: Status badge on a form that does not accept submissions. Same agreement as list.status.active.
list.empty.title: Empty state title when no form exists yet. ≤3 words.
list.empty.message: Body under that title. One sentence: creating a form is how submissions start arriving from the customer's own website.
list.empty.action: Primary button in that empty state. The + glyph stays in markup. Imperative, ≤3 words. Polish: 'Utwórz' (a new object), not 'Dodaj'.
list.create.title: Heading of the create-form dialog. ≤3 words. Polish headings are nouns, so 'Nowy formularz' rather than an imperative.
list.create.template: Field label AND aria-label of the starting-template picker. 1 word.
list.create.name: Field label for the form's name. Required — the asterisk is rendered separately. 1 word.
list.create.slug: Field label for the URL slug. Required — the asterisk is rendered separately. 1 word.
list.create.slugPlaceholder: Placeholder showing the SHAPE of a slug: lowercase ASCII words joined by hyphens. Write a plausible slug in the reader's own language; never a sentence, never diacritics.
list.create.slugHint: Hint under the slug input listing what the input accepts. No trailing period.
list.create.active: Checkbox in the dialog: the new form accepts submissions immediately. Same agreement as list.status.active.
list.delete.title: Title of the delete confirmation. A question, ≤3 words. Polish: infinitive, e.g. 'Usunąć formularz?'.
list.delete.message: Body of that confirmation. {name} is the form's name, wrapped in the locale's own quote marks. Two facts: it cannot be undone, and submissions already collected survive.
list.delete.confirm: The destructive button in that confirmation. Names the action AND the object — never a bare 'OK'. ≤3 words.
detail.unsavedChanges: Warning chip in the top bar while the builder has edits that were not saved. Noun phrase, ≤2 words.
detail.save: Primary top-bar button that saves the form. Imperative, ≤3 words. The 'saving…' state reuses common.actions.saving.
detail.endpointToken: Label before the form's endpoint token, which follows in a <code> element. Ends with a colon. Glossary: endpoint unchanged. ≤2 words.
detail.general.title: Heading of the panel holding name/slug/kind/active. 1 word.
detail.general.name: Field label for the form's name. 1 word.
detail.general.slug: Field label for the URL slug. 1 word.
detail.general.slugHint: Hint under that slug input listing what it accepts. No trailing period.
detail.general.kind: Field label AND aria-label of the form-type picker. 1 word.
detail.general.active: Checkbox: the form accepts submissions. Same agreement as list.status.active.
detail.schema.title: Heading of the field editor — the main job on this page. ≤2 words. 'Schema' is the DB column name; call them the form's fields.
detail.schema.applyTemplate: aria-label of the template picker in the field editor. Imperative, ≤2 words.
detail.schema.applyTemplatePlaceholder: Placeholder of that same picker while nothing is chosen. Ends with an ellipsis character.
detail.schema.apply: Button that applies the chosen template. Imperative, 1 word.
detail.schema.addField: Button that appends an empty field. The + glyph stays in markup. Imperative, ≤3 words.
detail.schema.emailHint: Explains why a required 'email' field is mandatory. Rendered with <i18n-t>: {code} is a slot holding the literal identifier 'email' in a <code> element, so it must NOT be translated and the sentence must keep it mid-sentence. One sentence.
detail.schema.empty.title: Empty state title when the form has no fields. ≤3 words.
detail.schema.empty.message: Body under it. One sentence naming the two ways forward: add a field, or apply a template.
detail.schema.fieldName: Field label for the field's machine name — the JSON key submitted by the site. ≤2 words.
detail.schema.fieldNamePlaceholder: Placeholder showing the shape of a machine name (lowercase ASCII, snake_case). Translate only the 'e.g.' part; keep the identifier example ASCII, because that is what the value must be.
detail.schema.label: Legacy single-label caption (kept for parity). Prefer labelEn / labelPl. 1 word.
detail.schema.labelEn: Field label for the English visitor-facing label stored in forms.schema (ADR-0025). Short; keep the (EN) marker.
detail.schema.labelEnPlaceholder: Placeholder for the English visitor label. Example may stay English; only localize the 'e.g.' / 'np.' prefix.
detail.schema.labelPl: Field label for the Polish visitor-facing label stored in forms.schema (ADR-0025). Short; keep the (PL) marker.
detail.schema.labelPlPlaceholder: Placeholder for the Polish visitor label. Fully localized example is fine — it demonstrates authored PL copy.
detail.schema.labelPlaceholder: Legacy placeholder for the single label field. Prefer labelEnPlaceholder / labelPlPlaceholder.
detail.schema.type: Field label AND aria-label of the field-type picker. 1 word.
detail.schema.required: Checkbox marking the field as mandatory for the visitor. 1 word.
detail.schema.options: Field label for the dropdown's choices, entered as one comma-separated line. The parenthetical explains the format.
detail.schema.optionsPlaceholder: Placeholder showing three example dropdown choices separated by commas. Fully localized — it only demonstrates the comma format.
detail.schema.remove: Button deleting one field from the editor. Imperative, 1 word. No confirmation — nothing is persisted until save.
detail.schema.removeAria: aria-label of that same button. {position} is the field's 1-based position, because several identical buttons are on screen.
detail.schema.moveUpAria: aria-label of the ↑ button on a field row. {position} is the field's 1-based position.
detail.schema.moveDownAria: aria-label of the ↓ button on a field row. {position} is the field's 1-based position.
detail.submissions.title: Heading above the submission table. PLURAL on {count} — Polish needs three forms. Glossary: submission → zgłoszenie.
detail.submissions.columns.date: Table column header: when the submission arrived. 1 word.
detail.submissions.columns.contact: Table column header: the contact the submission was matched to, by email. 1 word.
detail.submissions.columns.referer: Table column header: the page the submission was sent from (the HTTP referer). ≤1 word; describe it as the source rather than transliterating 'referer'.
detail.submissions.empty.title: Empty state title when the form has no submissions. ≤3 words.
detail.submissions.empty.message: Body under it. One sentence: submissions arriving from the customer's site land here.
detail.submissions.viewContact: Row action linking to the matched contact's page. ≤3 words.
detail.inquiries.title: Heading above the inquiry table on an inquiry-destination form. PLURAL on {count}. Glossary: inquiry → zgłoszenie.
detail.inquiries.columns.date: Table column header: when the inquiry arrived. 1 word.
detail.inquiries.columns.status: Table column header: inquiry status. 1 word.
detail.inquiries.columns.email: Table column header: visitor email. 1 word.
detail.inquiries.columns.summary: Table column header: AI summary. 1 word.
detail.inquiries.empty.title: Empty state title when the inquiry form has no inquiries. ≤3 words.
detail.inquiries.empty.message: Body under it. One sentence: inquiries from this form appear here for review.
detail.inquiries.view: Row action opening the inquiry detail. Imperative, 1 word.
detail.discard.title: Title of the confirmation shown when navigating away with unsaved edits. A question. Polish: infinitive.
detail.discard.message: Body of it. Two sentences at most: there are unsaved changes, and leaving throws them away. Impersonal — the form has the changes, not 'you'.
detail.discard.confirm: The button that leaves and loses the edits. Names the action AND the object. ≤3 words.
detail.replaceFields.title: Title of the confirmation before a template overwrites the fields already on the form. A question. Polish: infinitive.
detail.replaceFields.message: Body of it. One sentence: applying a template replaces every existing field, not just the empty ones.
detail.replaceFields.confirm: The button that performs the replacement. Names the action AND the object. ≤3 words.
detail.validation.nameRequired: Client-side save blocker: the name is empty. One short sentence, states the fact.
detail.validation.slugFormat: Client-side save blocker: the slug has characters the server rejects. Say what is allowed.
detail.validation.fieldNameRequired: Client-side save blocker: at least one field has no machine name. One short sentence.
detail.validation.duplicateFieldName: Client-side save blocker: two fields share a machine name. {name} is that name, wrapped in the locale's own quote marks. Say the names must be unique.
detail.validation.selectNeedsOptions: Client-side save blocker: a dropdown field has no choices. {name} is the field's machine name (or detail.validation.unnamedField), wrapped in the locale's own quote marks.
detail.validation.unnamedField: Substituted for {name} above when the offending field has no name yet. Lowercase — it lands mid-sentence inside quote marks. ≤2 words.
detail.validation.emailFieldRequired: Client-side save blocker: a form with fields has no required 'email' field. {field} is the literal schema identifier 'email' and must NOT be translated — that is why it is a parameter. Explain that submissions are matched to contacts by email.
preview.untitledForm: Stands in for the form's name in the preview panel while the name is empty. ≤3 words.
preview.caption: Caption under the preview title explaining that this panel mirrors what the customer's site visitors will see. One short phrase; the dash is spaced.
preview.empty: Shown in the preview panel while the form has no fields. One short sentence.
preview.localeAria: aria-label of the EN/PL switcher on the form preview (visitor labels, ADR-0025). ≤3 words.
preview.localeEn: Short code on the preview language switcher for English. Keep as EN (endonym/code, not translated).
preview.localePl: Short code on the preview language switcher for Polish. Keep as PL (endonym/code, not translated).
preview.untitledField: Stands in for a field's label in the preview while both its label and name are empty. ≤3 words.
preview.optionPlaceholder: The single visible option of a dropdown in the preview when the operator has not entered any choices yet. 1 word.
preview.submit: The disabled submit button inside the preview. This is preview chrome, not stored data: the real button lives on the customer's site. Imperative, 1 word.
integration.title: Heading of the panel with copy-pasteable integration snippets. 1 word.
integration.copyEndpoint: Button copying the public submit URL to the clipboard. Imperative, ≤4 words. Glossary: endpoint unchanged.
integration.copy: Button copying the currently shown code snippet. Imperative, 1 word.
integration.tabsAria: aria-label of the tablist holding the JSON / curl / SDK / Codegen examples. Those four tab labels are proper nouns and are never translated. ≤2 words.
integration.submitUrl: Label before the public submit URL, which follows in a <code> element. Ends with a colon. ≤2 words.
integration.toast.endpointCopied: Toast after the endpoint URL reaches the clipboard. ≤3 words, past tense.
integration.toast.copied: Toast after a code snippet reaches the clipboard. ≤2 words, past tense.
integration.errors.copy: Shown when the clipboard API refused. Says what happened and what to do instead — select the text by hand.
analytics.title: Page heading of the forms analytics page. ≤2 words.
analytics.filters.range: Field label of the from–to date filter, now one AppDateRangePicker rather than two date inputs. ≤2 words.
analytics.filters.form: Field label AND aria-label of the form filter. 1 word.
analytics.filters.allForms: Placeholder and first option of that filter — means no filter. ≤2 words.
analytics.stats.total: Label of the big number counting every submission in range. CSS uppercases it, so give sentence case. ≤2 words.
analytics.stats.activeForms: Label of the big number counting forms that accept submissions. CSS uppercases it, so give sentence case. ≤2 words.
analytics.byForm.title: Heading of the per-form breakdown table. ≤2 words.
analytics.byForm.empty.title: Empty state title when no submission falls in the selected range. ≤5 words.
analytics.byForm.empty.message: Body under it. One sentence naming the two fixes: widen the dates, or drop the form filter.
analytics.byForm.columns.form: Column header: the form's name. 1 word.
analytics.byForm.columns.submissions: Column header: submissions counted for that form. 1 word.
analytics.daily.title: Heading of the per-day bar chart. ≤2 words.
analytics.daily.barTitle: Native tooltip on one bar. PLURAL on {count} — Polish needs three forms. {date} is already formatted through d(), so never write a date into this string.
toast.created: Toast after a form is created. ≤3 words, past tense.
toast.deleted: Toast after a form is deleted. ≤3 words, past tense.
toast.saved: Toast after the builder saves. ≤3 words, past tense.
errors.loadList: Fallback when the form list could not be fetched and the server gave no message. Used by both the store and the list view. No trailing period.
errors.load: Fallback when one form could not be fetched. No trailing period.
errors.loadStats: Fallback when the analytics query failed. No trailing period.
errors.create: Fallback when creating a form failed. No trailing period.
errors.save: Fallback when saving the form failed — shown both inline and as a toast. No trailing period.
errors.delete: Fallback when deleting a form failed. No trailing period.
destination.label: Field label for where form submissions go: sales Lead path vs Inquiry review queue. ≤2 words.
destination.lead: Option: submissions create a Contact+Lead immediately (legacy). Glossary: lead stays 'lead'. 1 word.
destination.inquiry: Option: submissions become an Inquiry awaiting human Accept. Glossary: inquiry → zapytanie. 1 word.
intakeMode.label: Field label for how the public form collects answers (static schema vs adaptive AI dialogue). ≤2 words.
intakeMode.static: Option: classic one-shot form fields. 1 word.
intakeMode.adaptive: Option: conversational AI follow-ups (requires AI Compose). 1 word.
detail.validation.adaptiveLeadInvalid: Client-side save blocker: lead destination cannot use adaptive intake in v1. One short sentence.
detail.validation.adaptivePromptRequired: Client-side save blocker: adaptive inquiry needs a non-empty system prompt. One short sentence.
adaptive.title: Section heading for the adaptive intake config block (brief + system prompt). ≤3 words.
adaptive.brief.label: Field label for the operator intent textarea (3–4 sentences). ≤2 words.
adaptive.brief.hint: Helper under the brief field: write 3–4 sentences about what the form should gather. One short sentence.
adaptive.brief.placeholder: Placeholder example brief. One or two sentences the operator can replace.
adaptive.generate: Button that asks AI to draft the system prompt from the brief. Imperative, ≤3 words.
adaptive.generating: Button label while the draft request is in flight. ≤2 words.
adaptive.prompt.label: Field label for the editable system prompt textarea. ≤2 words.
adaptive.prompt.hint: Helper under the prompt: language-neutral guidance for the form. Visitor language (pl/en) is chosen at runtime, not here. One short sentence.
adaptive.prompt.placeholder: Placeholder when no prompt yet. One short sentence inviting generate or paste.
adaptive.opening.labelEn: Label of the English opening-question input. Mentions EN. ≤4 words.
adaptive.opening.labelPl: Label of the Polish opening-question input. Mentions PL. ≤4 words.
adaptive.opening.placeholderEn: Example English opening question shown as placeholder. One short question.
adaptive.opening.placeholderPl: Example Polish opening question shown as placeholder. One short question.
adaptive.opening.hint: Helper under both opening inputs: first visitor field, co-generated with the prompt, editable. One short sentence.
adaptive.errors.briefRequired: Inline error when Generate is clicked with an empty brief. One short sentence.
adaptive.errors.generate: Fallback when drafting the system prompt failed. No trailing period.
adaptive.errors.preview: Fallback when the form preview request failed. No trailing period.
adaptive.errors.savePromptFirst: Inline hint when trying to test the form before the form has a saved system prompt. One short sentence.
adaptive.preview.title: Heading of the live adaptive form test panel. ≤3 words.
adaptive.preview.caption: Caption under the form preview heading: opening → all follow-ups at once → contact details; answers do not create real inquiries. One short sentence.
adaptive.preview.empty: Unused empty-state key kept for parity; one short sentence.
adaptive.preview.inputPlaceholder: Placeholder of the active answer textarea in the adaptive form preview. ≤4 words. Visitor-facing (follows preview locale).
adaptive.preview.send: Legacy alias unused in UI; keep short imperative. 1 word.
adaptive.preview.sending: Primary button while waiting for the next adaptive field. ≤2 words.
adaptive.preview.reset: Button that clears the preview form and starts over. Imperative, ≤2 words.
adaptive.preview.ready: Banner when the preview form is complete. One short sentence.
adaptive.preview.openingFallback: Fallback first-question label when the form has no saved openingLabels yet. Real question, not 'Question 1'. One short question.
adaptive.preview.start: Primary button after the opening answer to fetch follow-up questions. Imperative, ≤2 words.
adaptive.preview.continue: Primary button after filling all follow-up fields, goes to contact step. Imperative, 1 word.
adaptive.preview.finish: Primary button on the contact step that completes the preview. Imperative, ≤2 words.
adaptive.preview.loadingTitle: Inline card title while AI plans follow-up questions. ≤4 words.
adaptive.preview.loadingBody: Inline card body under the spinner: preparing a few questions. One short sentence with ellipsis.
adaptive.preview.phaseQuestions: Chip label for the questions stage of the preview. 1 word.
adaptive.preview.phaseContact: Chip label for the contact stage of the preview. 1 word.
adaptive.preview.answersRequired: Inline error when Continue is clicked with empty follow-up fields. One short sentence.
adaptive.preview.contactIntro: Intro above name/email on the contact step. Visitor-facing. One short sentence.
adaptive.preview.contactName: Label of the name field on the contact step. Visitor-facing. ≤3 words.
adaptive.preview.contactNamePlaceholder: Placeholder for the name field. Visitor-facing. ≤3 words.
adaptive.preview.contactEmail: Label of the email field on the contact step. Visitor-facing. 1 word.
adaptive.preview.contactEmailPlaceholder: Placeholder for the email field (example address). Visitor-facing. Escape @ as {'@'} — bare @ breaks vue-i18n linked-message parsing.
adaptive.preview.contactInvalid: Inline error when name/email are missing or email looks invalid. One short sentence.
adaptive.toast.drafted: Toast after AI drafted a system prompt into the textarea. ≤3 words, past tense.
